gp.text: During the nine months ended December 31, 2024 (the “ 2024 period”), sales, cost of materials sold and adjusted gross profit decreased approximately $68.6 million, $46.0 million and $22.6 million, respectively, compared to the amounts recorded during the nine months ended December 31, 2023 (the “2023 period”).
